module_summary: AXI-Stream N:1 arbitrated mux: registered inputs feed an arbiter-selected mux whose output passes through a two-register skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-input valid vector; raises arbitration requests and loads input registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-input ready from empty input reg or granted port with internal ready; enables input capture.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated input stream payloads captured into input registers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Muxed output payload driven from the output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid driven by the output skid register valid.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; steers skid buffer transfers and internal ready.

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant from arbiter; gates input ready, request and acknowledge.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant index selects which registered input drives the output mux.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector from live or registered input valids.

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Releases grant at end of packet (tlast) when transfer accepted.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Indicates a grant exists; qualifies internal output valid.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Input register stage hiding arbitration delay; source of muxed data.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Registered input valids; drive ready, request and muxed valid.

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: Mux output: selected input's registered data.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid into skid buffer, qualified by ready and grant_valid.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready; gates input ready, ack and skid-buffer transfers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output register of skid buffer driving m_axis_tdata.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp register holding data when output stalls.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp occupancy; affects early ready and output refill.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads output register from internal mux data.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads temp skid register when output stalled.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp register contents into output register.

groups.name: Input register stage
groups.description: Per-port registers capturing input beats while ready, hiding arbitration latency.

groups.name: Arbiter
groups.description: Arbiter instance grants one input per packet, released on tlast acknowledge.

groups.name: Input mux
groups.description: Selects granted port's registered fields by grant_encoded into internal stream.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output plus temp register pair giving full-throughput registered AXIS output.
